Let us aim at the £250 mark before our next balance sheet is prepared in September. It was pleasing to note in the Daily Press recently, references to the efforts of one of our veteran members, Capt.
Michael once again squeezing into third place. A very poor entry was seen in the Veterans race and here H.
The 100 yards Veterans resulted in only four runners facing the starter; and that old war-horse, Dick Best, added to his list of "pots" by annexing first prize. H.
Three club handicaps were included in the afternoon's sport and in the 100 Yds. the veterans came into their own by providing the first two in H.
